meadow = a field of grass and wild flowers
field = an area of land used for crops or grass
mountain = a very high area of land
hill = a raised area of land, smaller than a mountain
river = a large natural stream of water that flows to the sea
lake = a large area of water surrounded by land
pond = a small area of still water
ocean = a very large sea
wave = a moving ridge of water on the sea
tide = the regular rise and fall of the sea
cliff = a high, steep rock face, often by the sea
cave = a large hole in rock or underground
tree = a tall plant with a wooden trunk
leaf = the flat green part of a plant
branch = an arm of a tree that grows from the trunk
root = the part of a plant that grows under the ground
seed = the small part of a plant from which a new plant can grow
flower = the colourful part of a plant that makes seeds
grass = the short green plants that cover lawns and fields
bush = a plant with many woody stems, smaller than a tree
